title: Jethro Visits Moses

questions.question: Who was Jethro?
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:1 (ESV): "Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father-in-law, heard of all that God had done."

questions.question: Who did Jethro bring to Moses in the wilderness?
options: Moses' wife Zipporah and his two sons
questions.correctAnswer: Moses' wife Zipporah and his two sons
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:5 (ESV): "Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness."

questions.question: What did Jethro say when he heard what God had done?
options: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods
questions.correctAnswer: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:11 (ESV): "Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods."

questions.question: What was Moses doing all day that concerned Jethro?
options: Judging the people from morning to evening
questions.correctAnswer: Judging the people from morning to evening
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:13 (ESV): "Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from morning till evening."

questions.question: What did Jethro advise Moses to do?
options: Appoint capable men as leaders over groups
questions.correctAnswer: Appoint capable men as leaders over groups
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:21 (ESV): "Look for able men from all the people... and place such men over the people as chiefs."

questions.question: What were the names of Moses' two sons?
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:3-4 (ESV): "The name of the one was Gershom... and the name of the other, Eliezer."

questions.question: What qualities did Jethro say the appointed leaders should have?
options: Able, God-fearing, trustworthy, and hating a bribe
questions.correctAnswer: Able, God-fearing, trustworthy, and hating a bribe
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:21 (ESV): "Able men from all the people, men who fear God, who are trustworthy and hate a bribe."

questions.question: Over how many people were the different levels of leaders placed?
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:21 (ESV): "Chiefs of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens."

questions.question: What did Jethro offer along with Moses and Aaron?
options: A burnt offering and sacrifices to God
questions.correctAnswer: A burnt offering and sacrifices to God
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:12 (ESV): "Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God."

questions.question: What kind of cases would still come to Moses?
options: Only the great matters; small matters the leaders would judge
questions.correctAnswer: Only the great matters; small matters the leaders would judge
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:22 (ESV): "Every great matter they shall bring to you, but any small matter they shall decide themselves."

questions.question: What did the name Gershom mean?
options: I have been a sojourner in a foreign land
questions.correctAnswer: I have been a sojourner in a foreign land
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:3 (ESV): "The name of the one was Gershom (for he said, 'I have been a sojourner in a foreign land')."

questions.question: What did the name Eliezer mean?
options: The God of my father was my help
questions.correctAnswer: The God of my father was my help
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:4 (ESV): "The name of the other, Eliezer (for he said, 'The God of my father was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh')."

questions.question: What warning did Jethro give Moses about judging alone?
options: You and the people will wear yourselves out
questions.correctAnswer: You and the people will wear yourselves out
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:18 (ESV): "You and the people with you will certainly wear yourselves out, for the thing is too heavy for you."

questions.question: Who came to eat bread with Jethro before God?
options: Aaron and all the elders of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron and all the elders of Israel
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:12 (ESV): "Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before God."

questions.question: What did Jethro do after giving his advice?
options: He went away to his own country
questions.correctAnswer: He went away to his own country
questions.explanation: Exodus 18:27 (ESV): "Then Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went away to his own country."

key_verse_text: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods, because in this affair they dealt arrogantly with the people.
